Pronunciation[edit] IPA(key): /deˈd͡zembɾo/ Noun[edit] dezembro m (plural dezembros) December quotations ▼a. 1284, Alfonso X of Castile, Cantigas de Santa Maria, Códice de Toledo, cantiga 413 (facsimile): e eſta feſta e no mes de dezenbro […] And this feast (day) is in the month of December […] Descendants[edit] Galician: decembro Portuguese: dezembro (see there for further descendants) Portuguese[edit] Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:dezembroWikipedia pt Alternative forms[edit] dez. (abbreviation) Dezembro (pre-1990 spelling, Portugal) Dezẽbro (obsolete, abbreviation) Etymology[edit] Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese dezembro, dezenbro, from Medieval Latin Decembrius, from Latin December.
